title: Claims of emergence in AI should be grounded in information decomposition
abstract: arXiv:2610.28479v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a language model develops capabilities not traceable to its individual components, when a multi-agent AI system outperforms each agent on its own, or when a human-AI pair succeeds where either fails in isolation, AI researchers describe it as a case of ``synergy'' or ``emergence''. However, these are usually informal assessments not supported by a theoretical framework, making these claims impossible to compare or even meaningfully dispute. Here we argue that \emph{information decomposition can serve as a unifying formal framework to operationalize assessments about synergy in AI systems}. Information decomposition provides a way to distinguish qualitatively different \emph{types} of information, including unique information available from individual components, redundant information shared across multiple components, and synergistic information accessible only from parts taken together. translated_title: AI中的涌现论断应当以信息分解为理论基础
translated_abstract: 当语言模型发展出无法追溯到其单个组件的能力时，当多智能体AI系统的表现超过其中每个单独的智能体时，或者当人机组合在两者单独都无法成功的情况下取得成功时，AI研究者会将其描述为“协同”或“涌现”的案例。然而，这些通常是非正式的评估，缺乏理论框架的支持，使得这些论断既无法相互比较，甚至也无法进行有意义的争辩。本文论证，信息分解可以作为一个统一的形式化框架，用于将AI系统中关于协同性的评估操作化。信息分解提供了一种区分性质不同的信息类型的方法，包括可从单个组件获得的独特信息、跨多个组件共享的冗余信息，以及只有将各部分结合在一起才能获得的协同信息。这使得涌现论断具有了精确的、可证伪的形式。
tldr: 本文主张以信息分解作为统一的形式化框架，将AI系统中关于涌现与协同的非正式论断转化为精确、可比较且可证伪的评估。
